description: Bounded single agent that turns requested recipes (sandbox catalog or attached recipe text) into a merged, unit-normalized, categorized grocery plan scaled to user-stated servings. Asks when servings or the recipe are missing/ambiguous, treats external text as untrusted data, never buys/orders/pays (blocked), and stops on explicit step, token, time and retry budgets.

status_policy.completed: goal_completed - plan built for the requested recipes and servings (or question answered)
status_policy.needs_clarification: clarification_required - servings missing, recipe ambiguous or unknown
status_policy.blocked: autonomy_boundary (purchase/order/payment/delivery/messaging requested; a draft plan may be included) | out_of_scope | policy_blocked
status_policy.approval_required: not used: no consequential action can be approved in this sandbox
status_policy.tool_error: tool_failure - tool still failing after bounded retries
status_policy.failed: model_unavailable | model_timeout | model_rate_limited | model_provider_error | agent_reported_failure | internal_error

example_request.task: Create a grocery plan for spaghetti bolognese for 6 people and greek salad for 2. I already have olive oil.
